description: Lisbon Lake is a popular fishing lake. It is one of the few lakes in the Cranbrook area accessible by mountain bike, ATV or snowmobile. A trail extends another kilometer along the north shore of this unusually long, narrow lake, giving access to the entire length of the lake for those willing to walk.
directions:
From Cranbrook follow highway BC95a, turn left onto Wycliffe Park road for 6.5 kms, then turn left onto Old Wycliffe road, after 800m turn right onto Perry Creek Road, follow Perry Creek road, staying left at the intersection with St Mary's Rd, and Right at the intersection with Watson road, the turnoff for the trailhead is just past the 10km road marker, look for the "trailhead right post" Follow this road for 600m then turn left up Antwerp Creek, this is a good spot to park vehicles and walk in, the road up Antwerp Creek is 3.4kms long, rough and narrow. There is parking at the end of Antwerp Creek, Scratches on your vehicle are likely along this section.
